children: Tongda International Group Co., which provides a membership-based e-commerce platform through its subsidiaries in China, filed for a 5 million share initial public offering with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

The Cayman Islands holding company said it expects its IPO to price between $5 and $6 per share. The company said it has reserved the ticker symbol TDHG and will apply to list its shares on the Nasdaq Capital Market.
The company said it offers groceries, personal care products, and higher item goods including electronics, fashion, and luxury items, among others.
